cases.purpose: Reject saving over a symbolic link instead of replacing it while leaving its target unchanged.
cases.oracle: Independent shell file and symlink readback after failed save.
cases.comparison: Nonzero status, error diagnostic, preserved link and data, no temporary file.
cases.script:
printf source > src
printf target > target
/usr/bin/ln -s target dest || exit 125
rc=0
nano2 save src dest >out 2>err || rc=$?
[[ $rc != 0 && -L dest && $(<target) == target && $(<src) == source && ! -s out && -s err ]] || exit 1
compgen -G '.nano2.*' >/dev/null && exit 1
printf 'symlink preserved and save rejected\n'
